title: Service locator
description: The France-services locator pattern: address autocomplete input with geolocation button and result cards. Observed live on service-public.gouv.fr.

components.reason: Address entry — the suggestion list is a custom pattern (DSFR has no official autocomplete component); keep fr-input + a role='listbox' suggestion list
'Utiliser votre position' geolocation action (fr-icon-map-pin-2-line style icon)
One card per located France services point

nesting: Input + geolocation button side by side; result cards below
validationOrder: The suggestion list is announced via an aria-live region or listbox semantics
Geolocation requires a user gesture and a permission fallback for manual entry
Never make the input a required field — geolocation is an alternative
a11yNotes: Pattern note: this composition is NOT an official DSFR component — it is the field-observed France-services locator implemented with fr-input + fr-btn
Suggestion selection must be keyboard operable
agentPromptSequence: 1. Place the address input with its label and hint
2. Add the geolocation button beside it
3. Render located services as cards below
4. Wire the suggestion list with listbox semantics and aria-live announcements
